text:
**Status: supported.** Approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss were mapped on the property in 2021, representing 2.23% of its area. The current assessment corroborates the loss using later observations and the 2020 forest reference map; an earlier pending assessment has been superseded.

Of the mapped loss, 68.1 hectares were in mapped planted forest, 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, and none was in mapped native forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and were not counted as events.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change. The evidence does not determine the cause, responsibility, legality or regulatory compliance.
